description: The Dirección de Agua of the Costa Rican environment ministry publishes, through its national water information system SINIGIRH, a public map viewer, a technical viewer and a catalogue of geoservices. The WMS service in versions 1.1.0 and 1.3.0 serves layers of water use concessions, discharges to water bodies, rulings on water bodies as start and end points, aquifer outlines from CTI-AGUA and SENARA studies, and SENARA aquifer vulnerability maps. A separate page offers the georeferenced concessions, rulings and discharges in the public domain as compressed files for GIS software. Coverage is the national territory of Costa Rica. Access is free online by WMS and download, with a GeoNetwork metadata catalogue. Caveats: no licence was stated on the pages read, and the aquifer and vulnerability layers cover selected study areas, not the whole country. Simulation uses: mapping abstraction and discharge points for water supply and wastewater planning, and groundwater availability studies. Related records: the SIMASTIR groundwater monitoring network (data-costa-rica-simastir-groundwater-monitoring-network).
